title: acme-orders nightly import, triaged
subtitle: The import has failed on 2 and 3 October; what the log shows, how bad it is, and what would stop it. Written on 3 October at 09:00.

First move: roll back to d22ee8f tonight and run bug-hunt on the trace now. [high]

blocks.code:
Incident: nightly order import failing since 2 Oct
Severity: SEV2 (finance and the admin panel have no orders of 2 Oct; no workaround)    Status: identified
Since: 2 Oct 06:00 CEST                  Next update: 3 Oct 12:00

What we know
- The import of orders-2026-10-02.csv exits with an error at 06:00 on 2 and 3 Oct (log)
- The error is in amount parsing; the first failing run is the first run after the 1 Oct 18:05 deploy (log)
- Nothing from the failing file was saved; a re-run after a fix is safe (log, importer.py)

Impact
- No order of 2 Oct in the database since 2 Oct 06:00; 3 Oct not yet attempted

What was done
- 09:00 triage from the log (lead)

Next
- 09:15 root cause with bug-hunt (fix)
- 12:00 decision: roll back to d22ee8f tonight, or deploy the fix (lead)

items: Lead: decide between rollback and fix by 12:00; keep this timeline.
Comms: send the status update to finance now; next at 12:00.

Fix: run `bug-hunt` with the trace from acme-orders.log:10-26, `logs/acme-orders.log` and the repository: `/software-engineering:bug-hunt the nightly import exits 1 since 2 Oct, trace in logs/acme-orders.log`.
After the fix: `change-review` of the fix before deploy, and `postmortem` once a run succeeds.
